title: Public Relations & Social Media Campaigns
overview: This practical program develops the skills needed to plan, deliver, and evaluate integrated public relations and social media campaigns. Participants learn to translate organizational objectives into audience-focused messages, coordinate earned, owned, shared, and paid channels, engage journalists and online communities, manage reputational risks, and measure campaign effectiveness. The course emphasizes responsible communication, consistent brand positioning, and hands-on campaign development.
audience: Public relations officers, specialists, and managers.
Corporate communications, media relations, and public affairs professionals.
Social media managers, digital content creators, and community managers.
Government and corporate communication teams responsible for public engagement.
Team leaders overseeing reputation, stakeholder, or digital communication initiatives.
methodology: Interactive instructor-led sessions combine short briefings, real-world campaign cases, audience mapping workshops, media pitching exercises, message-writing practice, content-calendar development, social listening simulations, group critiques, and campaign performance analysis. Participants work in teams to develop and present an integrated PR and social media campaign plan.
competencies: Integrated campaign strategy and objective setting.
Audience research, segmentation, and stakeholder mapping.
Brand messaging, storytelling, and editorial planning.
Platform-specific social media content and community engagement.
Campaign coordination, governance, and crisis response.
Social listening, measurement, reporting, and optimization.
objectives: Define measurable PR and social media campaign objectives aligned with organizational priorities.
Identify priority audiences and select appropriate channels and communication tactics.
Develop coherent key messages and compelling content for different stakeholders.
Prepare media materials and conduct professional journalist outreach.
Build realistic content calendars, responsibilities, and approval workflows.
Coordinate organic, earned, influencer, and paid campaign activities responsibly.
Respond to audience feedback, misinformation, and emerging reputational risks.
Track meaningful campaign metrics and recommend improvements based on results.
Present a complete integrated campaign plan with budget, timeline, and evaluation approach.
